title: Pradova passes surveillance audit (simulated)
text: SIMULATED DOCUMENT. All names, events and figures are invented for the demo. Pradova Friction GmbH completed its annual surveillance audit for ISO 9001, IATF 16949 and ECE R90 without major findings. Revenue for 2025 reached EUR 112 million, an increase of 6 percent, and the equity ratio was 41 percent. The company employs about 520 people at its plant in Germany.
